en.topic_title: Trump says summit with Xi, Putin ‘making history’

zh.topic_title: Trump says summit with Xi, Putin ‘making history’

en.topic_title: Trump says summit with Xi, Putin ‘making history’
en.topic_summary:
The presidents of China, the United States and Russia held an unprecedented summit in China on Thursday, with Donald Trump saying the three men were “making history”.



China’s President Xi Jinping, US President Donald Trump and Russia’s President Vladimir Putin arrive for a trilateral meeting at Kylin Villa on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Summit in Shenzhen, in China’s southern Guangdong province, on November 19, 2026. Photo: Win M
